steps.do:
In get_accounts, find the earliest date_opened among the customer's checking accounts (any class, personal or business; ignore savings and cards). Count the days from it to the current time (get_time). A program can be recommended only if that count meets or exceeds its minimum:
- 14 days: Light Green.
- 30 days: Gold Years, Green Fee-Free, Light Blue, Blue, Green Account (checking).
- 45 days: Dark Green, Purple, Evergreen, Sky Blue.
- 60 days: Bluest, Hunter Green, Cobalt Blue, Navy Blue.
- 90 days: Lime Green, True Blue, World Blue.
- 120 days: Beige.
The account class the customer holds does not matter. If the customer has no checking account, or meets no program's minimum, tell them they are not yet eligible to refer and the date they will reach the lowest minimum. Give no recommendations, and stop.

Use the referral records in get_referrals, not what the customer remembers. The period is the current calendar year: from January 1 of the year shown by get_time up to the current time.
- For each account type, count the referrals submitted for it in that period, leaving out REJECTED ones (denied). Several caps are stated as a number of referrals per year.
- Remaining = the program's annual cap minus that count.
- Caps: Light Green 3; Green Fee-Free 4; Light Blue 5, Blue 5, Green Account (checking) 5; Gold Years 6, Dark Green 6, Purple 6, Evergreen 6; Bluest 8, Sky Blue 8; Hunter Green 10, Cobalt Blue 10, Navy Blue 10; Lime Green 12, World Blue 12; True Blue 15, Beige 15.

- If a program's remaining room depends on referrals that are not yet COMPLETE, or that have ERROR status, tell the customer the terms do not say whether those count.
- If the recorded count differs from what the customer remembers, tell them the recorded count.

For a business referral, apply this step when two or more business programs passed rank_accounts and either tie at the top under the customer's ranking basis, or the customer gave no ranking basis. If the current date (get_time) falls inside an active promotion window, recommend in that promotion's order among those programs:
- 11/01/2025-11/30/2025: Sky Blue first, then Lime Green.
- 10/12/2025-11/12/2025: Lime Green first, then Hunter Green.
Never let a promotion replace the account that meets the customer's stated requirement (for example the highest bonus) with one that does not. If both notices are active (11/01-11/12/2025) and they order the tied accounts differently, tell the customer both accounts meet their requirement and ask which they prefer.

steps.do:
Read each submit_referral reply.
- REJECTED: do not retry it right away. Explain what the status means (rolling window limit, or an ineligible referral).
- ERROR: tell the customer a system error occurred and that they can try again later.
- Referrals left for later: give the date a slot opens. The window runs from 9 days before the current time up to now, using get_referrals and the referrals just submitted; the slot opens at the timestamp of the oldest referral in it plus 9 days. Remind the customer that each referral submitted now occupies the window for 9 days from its own timestamp, and that the caps and any promotion notice will be rechecked then.

Referrer tenure, the rolling 9-day window and each program's calendar-year cap have been checked from the records, and any of the customer's figures that differ from the records have been corrected.
